title: Watching a total grow
description: You can inspect an accumulator after each addition.

steps.description: You start total at zero before the loop. range(1, 5) supplies 1, 2, 3 and 4.
The assignment adds i to the previous total. The next print shows the updated total on every pass.

steps.question: What is total after adding 3?
steps.answer: It is 6, after the earlier additions produced 1 and then 3.

steps.description: The running messages show totals 1, 3, 6 and 10. You see Final total: 10 after the loop.
